summary: Fists of Legend is a 2013 South Korean sports drama film directed by Kang Woo-suk. The note states that it is based on the popular webtoon of the same title, written by Lee Jong-gyu and illustrated by Lee Yoon-gyun. It names the film's main cast: Hwang Jung-min, Yoo Jun-sang, Yoon Je-moon, Lee Yo-won, and Jung Woong-in.
one_line: A 2013 South Korean sports drama film directed by Kang Woo-suk, adapted from the Lee Jong-gyu and Lee Yoon-gyun webtoon.
